items.title: 美日又出手了？日元跌破160後突然暴力拉升 市場瘋傳干預猜測
items.title_en: US and Japan Act Again? Yen Falls Below 160 Then Suddenly Surges, Sparking Intervention Rumors
paras: 日元周三(2日)盤中突然快速升值，在20國集團(G20)會議即將落幕之際，引發日本與美國可能再次進場干預匯市的揣測。由於當時沒有明顯新聞或總體經濟因素足以解釋這波走勢，市場交易室隨即傳出官方出手買進日元的說法。
日元稍早一度貶破160日元兌1美元，隨後突然急速反彈，但漲勢並未持續擴大。市場人士認為，160日元可能已成為美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本銀行(BOJ)共同防守的新底線。
美國銀行(BAC-US)外匯策略師Alex Cohen表示，市場仍對匯市干預保持高度警戒。部分交易員則認為，這波升勢可能只是市場掃除停損單，也就是日元貶破關鍵價位後，引發大量部位自動平倉；不過，仍不能排除相關走勢是由官方力量觸發。
Monex外匯交易員Andrew Hazlett表示，市場確實傳出官方干預的消息，但就本次波動幅度而言，他對這項說法持懷疑態度。然而，日元兌美元與歐元同時突然走強，也很難以其他原因解釋。
這次日元升幅仍小於約一個月前的行情。當時日元一度貶至約164日元兌1美元，創近40年低點，隨後東京與華府聯手進場支撐日元，推動日元反彈約5%。
那是美日自1998年以來首次協調買進日元，也是數十年來罕見的聯合匯市干預。兩國政府事後均暗示，如有必要不排除再次採取共同行動，大幅提高做空日元的風險。隨著160日元關卡再度失守，交易員正密切觀察官方是否已悄然出手，或準備進行新一輪干預。
paras_en: The yen suddenly surged mid‑session on Wednesday (the 2nd), just as the G20 summit was winding down, prompting speculation that Japan and the United States might intervene in the currency market again. Because there was no obvious news or macro‑economic factor to explain the move, market desks quickly began circulating rumors that officials were buying yen.

Earlier the yen had slipped past the ¥160 per US$1 mark, then abruptly rebounded, though the rally did not continue to expand. Market participants think the ¥160 level may have become a new defensive floor jointly defended by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and the Bank of Japan.

Bank of America (BAC-US) FX strategist Alex Cohen said the market remains on high alert for currency‑market intervention. Some traders believe the rise may simply be a market‑wide stop‑loss sweep—positions automatically liquidated after the yen broke a key level—but they do not rule out that the move was triggered by official forces.

Monex FX trader Andrew Hazlett noted that rumors of official intervention are indeed circulating, but given the modest size of this move he is skeptical of that claim. Still, the simultaneous strength of the yen against both the dollar and the euro is hard to explain by any other reason.

The current yen gain is smaller than the move about a month ago, when the yen briefly fell to around ¥164 per US$1, a near‑40‑year low, before Tokyo and Washington jointly stepped in to support it, pushing the yen up roughly 5%.

That episode marked the first coordinated yen‑buying by the United States and Japan since 1998 and was a rare joint intervention in decades. Both governments later hinted that, if necessary, they would not rule out another coordinated action, dramatically raising the risk of shorting the yen. With the ¥160 barrier breached again, traders are watching closely to see whether officials have already acted quietly or are preparing a new round of intervention.

items.title: 貝森特把日銀逼入死局！升息1碼怕市場不買單 不升日元恐再崩
items.title_en: Bessent Forces BOJ into a Deadlock! Raising Rates by One Point Risks Market Rejection; Not Raising Yen May Cause Further Collapse
paras: 日本銀行(BOJ)將於9月17日至18日召開政策會議，總裁植田和男正陷入罕見的進退兩難局面。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)近期公開敦促日本升息，市場也已完全反映本月升息1碼的預期；然而，日銀無論升息或按兵不動，都可能引發金融市場劇烈波動。
日銀目前政策利率為1%。期貨與交換市場顯示，投資人已完全反映本月升息1碼至1.25%的可能性。若日銀按兵不動，不僅將讓市場大感意外，也可能導致日元重挫，進一步推升進口成本與通膨。市場預估，日本通膨率今年稍後可能接近3%。
然而，僅升息1碼(25個基點)也未必足以穩定市場。日銀審議委員高田創周三(2日)提出可能採取更大幅度行動的構想，並暗示不排除連續升息，使一般幅度的升息可能更難滿足投資人期待。
摩根大通證券首席日本經濟學家Ayako Fujita表示，美方已將話說到這種程度，日銀若不採取行動恐怕會引發問題；但如果市場認為日銀只能在美國支持下升息，也可能損害政策效果及央行公信力。

日元與日債市場同陷不安

日本債市近期持續遭到拋售，10年期公債殖利率周二突破3%，為1996年以來首見；同期間，美國10年期公債殖利率逼近4.82%，升至貝森特上任前以來最高水準。
貝森特自去年起便多次敦促日銀收緊貨幣政策，主要擔心日本公債市場動盪外溢至美國。日元貶值也可能迫使日本出售持有的美債以進行匯市干預，進而加重美債賣壓並推升美國借貸成本。
樂天證券經濟研究所首席經濟學家、前日銀官員Nobuyasu Atago指出，貝森特之所以敦促日銀升息，是因為他相信此舉有助抑制全球公債殖利率上升，最終也將使美國受惠。
貝森特近日透過社群貼文、媒體訪問及會談持續向日本施壓，要求日銀「做正確的事」，並敦促東京結束再通膨政策。他本周在美國北卡羅來納州舉行的G20會議期間與植田和男會面，雙方討論如何透過健全的政策制定穩定通膨預期，並避免匯率過度波動。

不升息恐讓匯市干預成果付諸流水

植田和男至今未釋出日銀可能將行動延後至10月的訊號。他在G20會議後表示，政策委員會將把物價上行風險納入決策考量，被市場解讀為暗示9月可能升息。高田創隨後更提出連續升息的可能性；日銀最近一次升息是在6月，與前一次行動相隔6個月。
若日銀在市場已完全押注升息的情況下按兵不動，日元可能再度重挫，也可能招致貝森特強烈反應。美日7月31日罕見聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首次共同干預匯市，一度使日元從1986年來低點、約164日元兌1美元，回升至接近155日元。日元周三在紐約市場約報158.72日元，交易員仍警戒美日再次出手干預。
Marlborough Investment Management基金經理James Athey表示，日銀必須升息並發出更強硬訊號，否則先前支撐日元的努力可能付諸流水。他認為，日銀7月未在匯市干預與政治表態已經鋪路的情況下升息，是一項重大錯誤。
不過，分析師認為，日本長期殖利率上升的核心原因並非日銀政策，而是市場對政府財政赤字的疑慮。若日本政府無法提出可信的財政方針，即使日銀升息，也未必能同時阻止日元走弱與長期公債殖利率攀升。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will hold its policy meeting on September 17‑18, putting President Kazuo Ueda in a rare dilemma. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has recently urged Japan to raise rates, and markets have fully priced in a one‑point hike this month; however, whether the BOJ hikes or stays put could trigger sharp market turbulence.

The BOJ’s policy rate stands at 1%. Futures and swap markets show investors have fully priced in a one‑point rise to 1.25% this month. If the BOJ stays idle, it will not only surprise the market but could also cause the yen to slump, further raising import costs and inflation. Markets estimate Japan’s inflation rate may approach 3% later this year.

Yet, a single one‑point (25 basis points) hike may not stabilize the market. BOJ policy committee member Takada Sō announced on Wednesday (2) that a larger move might be considered, hinting that consecutive hikes are not ruled out, making a modest increase harder to satisfy investors’ expectations.

Morgan Stanley Securities chief Japanese economist Ayako Fujita said the U.S. has pushed the issue to this extent; if the BOJ does nothing, problems may arise. However, if the market believes the BOJ can only hike with U.S. support, it could damage policy effectiveness and central bank credibility.

The yen and Japanese bond market are both uneasy. Japan’s bond market has been under selling pressure, with the 10‑year yield breaking 3% on Tuesday for the first time since 1996; meanwhile, the U.S. 10‑year yield approached 4.82%, rising to its highest level since Bessent took office.

Since last year, Bessent has repeatedly urged the BOJ to tighten policy, mainly worried that volatility in Japan’s bond market could spill over to the U.S. A weaker yen could force Japan to sell its U.S. bonds to intervene in the FX market, further increasing selling pressure on U.S. bonds and raising U.S. borrowing costs.
Lotte Securities’ chief economist and former BOJ official Nobuyasu Atago said Bessent’s push for a hike stems from his belief that it will curb global bond yields, ultimately benefiting the U.S.

Bessent has recently used social media posts, media interviews, and talks to pressure Japan, urging the BOJ to "do the right thing" and push Tokyo to end its inflation policy. This week, during the G20 meeting in North Carolina, he met Ueda and discussed how sound policy could stabilize inflation expectations and avoid excessive currency volatility.

Ueda has not yet signaled that the BOJ might delay action until October. After the G20 meeting, he said the policy committee would incorporate price‑upward risk into decisions, which the market interpreted as a hint of a September hike. Takada Sō then suggested the possibility of consecutive hikes; the BOJ’s last hike was in June, six months after the previous one.

If the BOJ remains idle while markets have fully bet on a hike, the yen could slump again and provoke a strong reaction from Bessent. On July 31, the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen—a rare move since 1998—temporarily lifting the yen from its low of about 164 per dollar to nearly 155. On Wednesday, the yen traded around 158.72 in New York, with traders wary of another intervention.

James Athey, a fund manager at Marlborough Investment Management, said the BOJ must hike and send a stronger signal, otherwise previous efforts to support the yen could be wasted. He believes the BOJ’s July decision not to intervene in the FX market and make a political statement was a major mistake.

However, analysts say the core reason for rising long‑term yields in Japan is not BOJ policy but market concerns over government fiscal deficits. If the Japanese government cannot present a credible fiscal plan, even a BOJ hike may not simultaneously stop the yen from weakening and long‑term bond yields from climbing.

items.title: 全球債券大幅回檔！但與2022年慘烈災情相比仍是小巫見大巫
items.title_en: Global Bonds Plunge Sharply, Yet Still a Mere Trifle Compared to the 2022 Disaster
paras: 全球債券市場近期遭遇的拋售看來相當慘烈，但與四年前相比仍是小巫見大巫。
回顧2022年時，以聯準會(Fed)為首的各國央行展開半世紀以來最同步且迅速的貨幣政策緊縮行動，以對抗疫情後需求反彈所引發、又受到俄烏戰爭進一步推升的通膨，最終導致全球債券陷入一個世代以來首見的熊市。
如今這波拋售雖然把全球主要市場的債券殖利率推升至多年高點，但漲幅僅是2022年底那波行情的一小部分。
債券殖利率與價格走勢相反。彭博彙整的數據顯示，全球政府債券殖利率過去20日累計上升17個基點，遠低於當時20天內急升的62個基點。
以今年以來的高點至低點計算，債券價格下跌4.2%，與2022年高達23%的跌幅相去甚遠。
儘管目前債市拋售絲毫沒有停歇跡象，但殖利率迄今漲幅相對溫和，讓資深市場觀察人士稍感安心。
自1983年起便追蹤債券市場的投資管理公司GSFM駐雪梨顧問Stephen Miller說，「也許該吃顆定心丸，冷靜一下。我不能說債券現在是強力買進標的」，但以目前這類殖利率水準來看，對以收益為導向的投資人而言，「確實開始值得考慮」。
和2022年造成債市崩跌的原因相比，通膨這一次同樣是重要因素，尤其是伊朗戰爭推升能源價格的影響，但還有其他力量正在加重債券市場壓力。
日本、英國和美國等主要市場政府支出龐大，持續推高發債量，促使投資人要求更高報酬，才能持有較長天期的政府債券。與此同時，人工智慧(AI)熱潮需要龐大資金投入，也加劇資本競爭，進一步推高借貸成本。
即便如此，債券跌幅仍相對獲得控制，部分原因在於目前殖利率是從較高水準上升，因此能提供投資人更大的利息收入緩衝，以抵銷債券價格下跌的影響。相較之下，2022年初殖利率仍接近歷史低點。
今年彭博全球國債總報酬指數成分債券的平均票面利率為2.68%，從2022年的1.84%上升。
摩根大通資產管理公司(JPMorgan Asset Management)駐墨爾本全球市場策略師Kerry Craig說：「對每個經濟體而言，情況並沒有債市表現看起來那麼糟。」他指出，在澳洲等部分市場，投資人甚至可能高估央行升息幅度。
近期經濟數據也支持這項看法。美國部分關鍵經濟數據令人失望，7月非農就業人數下滑，零售銷售也意外下降。日本第2經濟季成長同樣低於預期。
儘管如此，目前還沒人敢斷言殖利率已經觸頂。在能源價格推升通膨的情況下，市場持續押注升息，加上大量政府發債把殖利率進一步推高，債券價格可能還有進一步下跌空間。
日本殖利率上升也是另一項潛在壓力來源，因為日本債券殖利率走高可能吸引全球資金回流日本。
作為全球借貸成本重要基準的10年期美債殖利率，在周三(2日)升至4.81%，創2023年底以來最高，進一步加重其他已開發市場債券的壓力。日本10年期公債殖利率周二觸及3%，為本世紀首次突破這一關卡。
不過從市場波動率降低這一點可以看出，投資人對這一波債市拋售的承受度正在提高：全球政府債券殖利率波動率，已從5月的56個基點高峰下降至37個基點。而在2022年，該指標曾大幅飆升，並在隔年3月攀抵約92個基點。
三井住友信託銀行(Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank)駐東京資深市場策略師Ayako Sera說：「債券市場的負面因素正在逐步累積，但截至目前為止，還沒有出現足以迫使投資人撤出市場的決定性催化劑。」
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: The recent sell‑off in the global bond market looks severe, but it is a mere trifle compared with four years ago.

Looking back to 2022, central banks led by the Federal Reserve launched the most synchronized and rapid monetary tightening in half a century to combat post‑pandemic demand rebound‑driven inflation that was further amplified by the Russia‑Ukraine war, ultimately plunging global bonds into a generational bear market.
Now this wave of selling has pushed yields in major markets to multi‑year highs, yet the rise is only a fraction of the surge seen at the end of 2022.

Bond yields move opposite to prices. Bloomberg‑compiled data show that global government bond yields have risen 17 basis points over the past 20 days, far below the 62‑basis‑point jump in the same span back then.
From this year’s peak to trough, bond prices have fallen 4.2%, a far cry from the 23% plunge recorded in 2022.
Although the bond‑market sell‑off shows no sign of abating, the modest rise in yields so far gives seasoned market observers a bit of comfort.

Stephen Miller, a Sydney‑based adviser at GSFM, which has tracked the bond market since 1983, said, “Maybe take a calming pill and step back. I can’t say bonds are a strong buy right now,” but at current yield levels, “they do start to look worth considering for yield‑focused investors.”

Compared with the drivers of the 2022 bond‑market collapse, inflation remains a key factor this time, especially the impact of the Iran war on energy prices, but other forces are also adding pressure to the market.

Large fiscal outlays in major economies such as Japan, the UK and the US keep issuance high, forcing investors to demand higher returns to hold longer‑dated sovereigns. At the same time, the AI boom requires massive capital, intensifying competition for funds and pushing borrowing costs higher.

Nevertheless, bond declines remain relatively contained, partly because yields are rising from already elevated levels, providing investors with larger interest‑income buffers to offset price drops. By contrast, yields at the start of 2022 were still near historic lows.
The average coupon of the bonds that make up Bloomberg’s Global Government Bond Total Return Index this year is 2.68%, up from 1.84% in 2022.

Kerry Craig, a global market strategist in Melbourne for JPMorgan Asset Management, said, “The situation isn’t as bleak as bond performance alone suggests for any economy.” He noted that in markets such as Australia, investors may even be over‑estimating central‑bank rate hikes.

Recent economic data support that view. Key U.S. indicators disappointed, with July non‑farm payrolls falling and retail sales unexpectedly dropping. Japan’s second‑quarter growth also came in below expectations.

Nonetheless, no one can yet claim yields have peaked. With energy‑price‑driven inflation, markets continue betting on further rate hikes, and massive sovereign issuance pushes yields higher, leaving room for bond prices to fall further.
Rising Japanese yields add another potential pressure source, as higher Japan bond yields could attract global capital back to Japan.

The benchmark 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield, a key global borrowing cost indicator, rose to 4.81% on Wednesday (the 2nd), its highest since the end of 2023, further stressing other developed‑market bonds. Japan’s 10‑year gilt hit 3% on Tuesday, a first‑century breakthrough.

However, lower volatility shows investors are becoming more tolerant of this bond‑sell‑off: global government bond yield volatility has fallen from a May peak of 56 basis points to 37 basis points. In 2022 the metric surged and reached about 92 basis points in March of the following year.

Ayako Sera, a senior market strategist in Tokyo for Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said, “Negative factors in the bond market are accumulating gradually, but so far there’s no decisive catalyst that would force investors out of the market.”
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: OPEC+不再增產了？10月產量政策料按兵不動
paras: 石油輸出國組織與夥伴國(OPEC+)預料將在周日(6日)會議上維持10月產量政策不變。在主要成員本月完成取消其中一層減產措施後，集團的政策重心正轉向2027年產量基準與配額談判。
《路透》周三(2日)引述3名知情人士消息報導，周日參與線上會議的7個OPEC+核心成員包括沙國、俄羅斯、伊拉克、科威特、阿爾及利亞、哈薩克及阿曼。會議預計於格林威治時間上午11時、台灣時間晚間7時開始。
上述國家今年大部分時間持續提高每月生產配額，但實際產量並未跟上原訂增產速度，主要原因是伊朗與烏克蘭戰事干擾波斯灣地區、俄羅斯及哈薩克的原油出口。
美伊戰爭持續衝擊荷姆茲海峽原油運輸，也削弱OPEC+影響油價與爭取市占率的能力。與過去相比，集團調整供應政策對市場的作用已較為有限。
OPEC+在8月初同意本月進一步增產，完成逐步取消2023年達成的每日165萬桶減產措施。當時阿拉伯聯合大公國仍是成員，但阿聯已於今年5月退出OPEC。
不過，OPEC+目前仍保留另一層減產措施，涵蓋這個擁有21個成員的集團中大多數國家，效期持續至2026年底。各成員的實際產能也正接受評估，以決定2027年產量基準，並作為未來分配生產配額的依據。
負責評估多數成員產能的美國德州顧問公司DeGolyer and MacNaughton，預計9月底向OPEC提交報告，為年底會議制定新產量基準鋪路。不過，由於部分成員希望爭取更高配額，談判預料將相當艱難。
伊拉克等國主張自身產能已經提升，現行配額應予上調。阿聯退出OPEC的部分原因，也是認為配額未能反映其不斷擴大的生產能力。《彭博》上周則報導，委內瑞拉也在考慮退出OPEC，顯示集團內部對產量分配的爭議持續升溫。

items.title: Uber突然大裁員！3300人丟飯碗 完全遠距員工只留1%
items.title_en: Uber Announces Massive Layoffs: 3,300 Jobs Cut, Only 1% of Staff Remain Fully Remote
paras: 叫車平台Uber(UBER-US)周三(2日)宣布，將在全球裁減約3,300個職位，相當於員工總數的10%，為新冠疫情以來最大規模裁員。公司希望藉此精簡管理層級、加快決策速度，並將節省的資金重新投入叫車、外送及無人計程車業務。消息激勵Uber股價走揚，盤中漲近1.7%。
執行長柯霍斯洛夏西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在內部信中表示，Uber過去5年營收接近成長兩倍，並推出新產品、跨足更多業務及擴大顧客規模，但快速成長也帶來更多管理層級、協調工作及權責不清等問題，部分適合公司規模較小時期的組織架構，如今已無法滿足需求。
他強調，這次調整並非否定受影響員工的貢獻，而是希望建立更精簡的組織，讓權責更加明確、決策更快速，使員工把更多時間投入產品開發及服務顧客，而非反覆協調。

大砍管理層、遠距職缺僅留1%

Uber將把管理職位減少20%，部分主管將改任不帶人的專業職務，但公司並未說明有多少主管會遭到裁撤，這次裁員也涵蓋非管理職員工。位於執行長以下至少7個管理層級的員工人數將減少20%，僅有一至兩名成員的「微型團隊」則將縮減近半。
公司也將整併部分重疊部門，包括把餐廳、零售及白牌外送服務的3個營運團隊統合，並合併核心服務工程與科學團隊，希望簡化組織架構及提高資本配置效率。
Uber同時進一步收緊遠距工作政策，未來僅約1%的員工可以完全遠距辦公，絕大多數現有遠距員工將被要求轉往辦公室。全球團隊將集中在紐約與舊金山等主要據點，區域、地方及科技團隊也會移往指定中心，並持續執行每周進辦公室3天的混合工作制度。
這是Uber自2020年5月以來最大規模裁員。當時疫情導致叫車需求崩跌，公司裁減6,700人、接近員工總數四分之一。完成本輪裁員後，Uber員工總數將降至略低於3萬人，大致回到2021年的水準。

省下資金轉攻無人計程車

這次重整正值Uber面臨無人計程車競爭升溫。Waymo目前透過Uber應用程式在奧斯汀與亞特蘭大提供服務，但也持續在未與Uber合作的市場獨立擴張；特斯拉(TSLA-US)等競爭對手同樣加快布局，使投資人擔心無人駕駛車隊壯大後，可能削弱Uber連結車輛與乘客的中介地位。
為守住市場地位，Uber承諾未來數年投入超過100億美元發展無人計程車合作，投資開發自駕系統的業者，並將自身打造為乘客叫車時首選的無人駕駛服務平台。公司過去一年也重新調整資本配置，投資Avride、Lucid(LCID-US)、Nuro及Rivian(RIVN-US)等業者。
柯霍斯洛夏西並未像部分科技業主管一樣，將裁員直接歸因於AI，但組織調整同樣包含擴大運用AI處理日常營運。今年科技業以提升AI效率為由的裁員潮持續，Layoffs.fyi統計顯示，近390家公司已合計裁減逾12.3萬人。
Uber今年股價累計下跌近8%，表現落後標普500指數及競爭對手Lyft(LYFT-US)。公司希望透過一次完成大規模重整，降低反覆調整對員工的干擾，並把節省的成本投入成長、創新、司機、外送員與商家服務，以及無人駕駛的長期布局。
paras_en: Ride‑hailing platform Uber (UBER‑US) announced on Wednesday (the 2nd) that it will cut roughly 3,300 positions worldwide, about 10% of its workforce, marking the largest layoff since the COVID‑19 pandemic. The company says the move will streamline management layers, speed up decision‑making and redeploy the saved capital into ride‑hailing, delivery and autonomous‑taxi businesses. The news lifted Uber’s share price, which rose about 1.7% intraday.

CEO Dara Khosrowshahi wrote in an internal memo that Uber’s revenue has nearly doubled over the past five years while the firm launched new products, entered more businesses and expanded its customer base. However, that rapid growth also added management layers, coordination burdens and unclear responsibilities, and structures that made sense when the company was smaller no longer meet its needs.

He stressed that the restructuring does not diminish the contributions of affected employees; rather, it aims to create a leaner organization with clearer accountability and faster decisions, allowing staff to spend more time on product development and serving customers instead of endless coordination.

A major cut to management and a near‑total end to remote‑only roles. Uber will reduce management positions by 20%, with some supervisors shifted to individual contributor roles that have no direct reports. The company did not disclose how many managers will be let go, and the layoffs also affect non‑managerial staff. Employees at least seven levels below the CEO will see a 20% headcount reduction, and “micro‑teams” of one or two people will be cut by almost half.

The firm will also consolidate overlapping departments, merging three operations teams that handle restaurants, retail and white‑label delivery into a single unit, and combining core services engineering with the science team, in order to simplify the org chart and improve capital allocation efficiency.

Uber is tightening its remote‑work policy, allowing only about 1% of employees to work fully remotely in the future; the vast majority of current remote workers will be required to return to the office. Global teams will be concentrated in major hubs such as New York and San Francisco, while regional, local and tech teams will move to designated centers and continue a hybrid schedule of three days in the office per week.

This is Uber’s biggest layoff since May 2020, when the pandemic caused a collapse in ride‑hailing demand and the company cut 6,700 jobs—nearly a quarter of its workforce. After this round, Uber’s headcount will fall to just under 30,000, roughly returning to its 2021 level.

Saving cash to fund autonomous taxis. The restructuring comes as competition in driverless‑car services heats up. Waymo currently offers rides through the Uber app in Austin and Atlanta but is also expanding independently in markets where it does not partner with Uber; rivals such as Tesla (TSLA‑US) are accelerating their own efforts, prompting investors to worry that a large autonomous fleet could erode Uber’s role as the intermediary between drivers and passengers.

To protect its market position, Uber has pledged to invest more than $10 billion over the next few years in autonomous‑taxi collaborations and in companies developing self‑driving technology, positioning itself as the preferred platform for passengers when autonomous rides become available. Over the past year the company also reshuffled capital toward investments in Avride, Lucid (LCID‑US), Nuro and Rivian (RIVN‑US).

Khosrowshahi did not, unlike some tech CEOs, blame AI directly for the layoffs, but the reorganization does include broader use of AI for routine operations. This year’s tech‑sector wave of AI‑driven cuts continues, with Layoffs.fyi reporting that nearly 390 companies have collectively shed more than 123,000 jobs.

Uber’s stock has fallen almost 8% so far this year, underperforming the S&P 500 and rival Lyft (LYFT‑US). The company hopes that a single, large‑scale restructuring will reduce the disruptive impact of repeated adjustments on employees and redirect the saved costs into growth, innovation, drivers, couriers, merchant services and the long‑term rollout of autonomous driving.

items.title: 〈財報前瞻〉市值蒸發5200億美元 博通能靠AI財測上演輝達式大漲？
items.title_en: AVGO's Market Value Dwindles $520 Billion: Can AI Forecast Spark a Nvidia-Style Rally?
paras: 博通(AVGO-US)將於周三(2日)美股盤後公布會計年度第三季財報。在股價自6月高點重挫23%、市值蒸發約5,200億美元後，投資人期待這家全球市值第三大晶片製造商能複製輝達(NVDA-US)上周財報後的強勁漲勢，靠優於預期的業績與展望扭轉頹勢。
輝達上周公布亮眼財報，並預估下一個會計年度營收將成長70%，帶動股價創2025年4月以來最佳單日表現。持有博通股票的Advisors Capital Management投資組合經理JoAnne Feeney表示，如果博通管理層也提出強勁預測，股價可能出現類似反應。

財測陰影導致市值蒸發5200億美元

博通股價自6月2日創下歷史收盤新高以來下跌23%，成為同期標普500指數表現最差的30檔成分股之一，也抹去今年前5個月超過30%的大部分漲幅。
這波跌勢始於博通6月4日公布的第二季財報。公司當時預估第三季AI半導體營收將達160億美元，遠低於分析師預期的逾170億美元，導致股價隔日暴跌13%，創至少2009年以來最慘財報後表現。
這項預測也與博通第一季釋出的樂觀訊號形成強烈落差。執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)當時預估，2027年AI晶片銷售額將超過1,000億美元。Feeney指出，投資人尤其在意「超過」究竟代表多大上升空間，如果管理層能提供更明確細節，可能成為推升股價的重要催化劑。
華爾街預估，博通第三季每股盈餘將年增210%至2.63美元，營收則成長85%至294億美元。儘管超大規模雲端服務業者仍計畫投入數千億美元建設AI基礎設施，但晶片供應受限，投資人也日益擔心龐大資本支出能否轉化為實際報酬。
Laffer Tengler Investments資深股票分析師Jamie Meyers表示，市場瀰漫大量恐懼，而且並非博通獨有，而是籠罩整個AI交易。

AI客戶、毛利率與市占成財報焦點

股價大幅回落也讓博通估值變得較具吸引力。目前其預估本益比約21倍，略高於過去10年平均的18倍，但已遠低於去年12月的42倍及今年6月的32倍。Benchmark Equity Research分析師Cody Acree認為，這為短線投資創造更有利的進場條件。
除財務數據與展望外，投資人也將關注博通的客戶進展。蘋果(AAPL-US)7月宣布擴大與博通的合作，由博通供應新款客製化晶片，合作價值超過300億美元。博通也與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google、Anthropic、OpenAI及Meta(META-US)簽有長期合作協議。
市場也希望管理層證明，晶片需求並非由循環融資交易人為製造，並說明博通是否在客製化晶片市場遭到Alphabet與邁威爾(MRVL-US)搶走市占率。記憶體成本居高不下，使整體晶片業毛利率承壓，博通基礎設施軟體部門的營運狀況同樣是關注焦點。
即使財報全面優於預期，AI類股近期動能受挫，投資人態度轉趨謹慎，博通股價仍未必立即反彈。不過，看好長期前景的多頭認為，只要公司證明AI業務能維持陳福陽所說的「可持續且持續加速」成長軌跡，股價仍有可觀上漲空間。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) will announce its fiscal third-quarter earnings after the close on Wednesday (Feb. 2). After the stock plunged 23% from its June high and the company’s market value evaporated roughly $520 billion, investors are hoping the world’s third‑largest chipmaker can replicate Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) strong rally following last week’s earnings, turning the downturn around with better‑than‑expected results and outlook.

Last week, Nvidia released impressive earnings and projected next fiscal year revenue growth of 70%, driving the stock to its best single‑day performance since April 2025. Advisors Capital Management portfolio manager JoAnne Feeney, who holds Broadcom shares, said that if Broadcom’s management also issued a robust forecast, the stock could react similarly.

The shadow of earnings forecasts has caused a $520 billion market value loss. Broadcom’s share price has fallen 23% since hitting a record closing high on June 2, making it one of the 30 worst‑performing S&P 500 components for the period and wiping out most of the over‑30% gain seen in the first five months of the year.

The decline began with Broadcom’s Q2 earnings release on June 4. The company then projected Q3 AI‑semiconductor revenue of $16 billion, far below analysts’ expectation of over $17 billion, causing the stock to drop 13% the next day and marking its worst post‑earnings performance since at least 2009.

This forecast also starkly contrasted with the optimistic signals released in Q1. CEO Hock Tan had projected that AI chip sales would exceed $100 billion by 2027. Feeney noted that investors are particularly concerned about what “exceed” actually means in terms of upside potential, and that clearer detail from management could become a key catalyst for the stock’s rise.

Wall Street estimates Broadcom’s Q3 earnings per share to rise 210% to $2.63, with revenue growing 85% to $29.4 billion. Although large cloud‑service providers still plan to invest trillions of dollars in AI infrastructure, chip supply constraints and growing investor concern about whether massive capital expenditures will translate into real returns are mounting.
Jamie Meyers, senior equity analyst at Laffer Tengler Investments, said that the market is saturated with fear, and it’s not unique to Broadcom but blankets the entire AI trading space.

AI customers, gross margin, and market share are the focus of the earnings report. The sharp decline in share price has made Broadcom’s valuation more attractive. Its current price‑earnings ratio is about 21×, slightly above the 10‑year average of 18×, but far below the 42× seen in December 2023 and the 32× in June 2024. Benchmark Equity Research analyst Cody Acree believes this creates more favorable entry conditions for short‑term investors.

Beyond financial data and outlook, investors will also focus on Broadcom’s customer progress. Apple (AAPL-US) announced in July that it would expand its partnership with Broadcom, supplying new custom chips valued at over $30 billion. Broadcom also has long‑term agreements with Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiaries Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Meta (META-US).

The market also wants management to prove that chip demand is not merely a result of cyclical financing traders and to explain whether Broadcom has lost market share in the custom‑chip market to Alphabet and Marvell (MRVL-US). Rising memory costs are putting pressure on overall chip gross margins, and the operating condition of Broadcom’s infrastructure software division is also a focus.

Even if the earnings report exceeds expectations, AI stocks have recently lost momentum and investor sentiment has become more cautious, so Broadcom’s share price may not rebound immediately. However, long‑term bullish investors believe that as long as the company can demonstrate that its AI business can maintain the “sustainable and continuously accelerating” growth trajectory Hock Tan described, the stock still has significant upside potential.

items.title: 債市風暴！全球長債「雪崩式」重定價：日債殖利率破3%創30年高 美債刺破4.8%
items.title_en: Bond Market Storm! Global Long‑Bond ‘Avalanche’ Repricing: Japan Yields Break 3% to 30‑Year High, US Yields Surge Past 4.8%
paras: 一場橫跨東京、法蘭克福、雪梨與紐約的同步拋售潮在周三(2日)席捲全球先進經濟體長債市場。日本10年期國債殖利率盤中突破3%，為1996年10月以來首見10年期美債衝上4.8%，創2025年1月來新高，30年期同步摸高5.28%；德國、澳洲10年期殖利率分別刷新15年與十餘年高點，彭博全球公債指數殖利率報3.72%，創2008年中以來最高。
專家指出，中東局勢推升油價造成通膨預期回歸，聯準會(Fed)主席華許在傑克森霍爾釋放鷹派訊號，CME FedWatch顯示9月升息機率由不足40%飆至近70%，巴克萊轉而預測9月、12月各升息1碼。
日本方面，美國財長貝森特在G20期間呼籲日本央行(BOJ)「進一步升息」，日本財務大臣片山皋月淡化貨幣政策討論，但市場認為BOJ本月升息概率已逼近99%，催動日債殖利率曲線陡峭化，10年期期限溢價達150基點，被安聯稱為「全球零成本資金時代終結的領先指標」。
匯率方面，日元在美日7月30日至8月26日豪擲15.3993兆日元(約965億美元)聯合干預後，仍貶回160附近，今年迄今干預規模27.13兆日元超過2003年，市場揣測東京恐被迫拋美債護盤。
更深層問題則是市場對財政信任打折。五礦證券尤春野指出，華許對通膨容忍度明顯下降，要求底層通膨「明確且快速」回2%；中金則認為「財政主導」下，Fedㄐㄧㄤ難置身事外。
當10年美債4.8%對應無風險收益，標普500滾動本益比26倍(盈利收益率僅3.7)，股債性價比落入負值，是近20年來配置框架未見的倒掛。
道明證券則指出，黃金短線上承壓，但長線牛市未終。業內人士警告，若10年期美債殖利率飆破5%，全球組合再平衡將不再是微調，而是對「無風險利率錨」本身的重估。從日債破3到美債逼5，市場正為過去40年的長債牛市舉行閉幕式。
paras_en: A synchronized sell‑off that spanned Tokyo, Frankfurt, Sydney and New York swept the long‑bond markets of advanced economies on Wednesday (the 2nd). Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield breached 3% intraday, the first time since October 1996; the US 10‑year yield jumped above 4.8%, a peak not seen since January 2025, while the 30‑year rose to 5.28%. Germany’s and Australia’s 10‑year yields each hit fresh 15‑year‑plus highs, and Bloomberg’s Global Aggregate Bond Index yield rose to 3.72%, the highest since mid‑2008.

Experts say that Middle‑East tensions have pushed oil prices up, reviving inflation expectations. Fed Chair Jerome Powell delivered a hawkish signal at Jackson Hole, and CME’s FedWatch showed the probability of a September rate hike climbing from under 40% to near 70%. Barclays now forecasts a 25‑basis‑point hike in both September and December.

In Japan, US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen urged the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to “further raise rates” during the G20, while Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki downplayed monetary‑policy debate. Nevertheless, the market now sees a near‑99% chance of a BOJ hike this month, steepening the Japanese yield curve and pushing the 10‑year term premium to 150 basis points – a metric Allianz calls a leading indicator that the era of “global zero‑cost funding” is ending.

On the currency front, after a coordinated intervention of ¥15.3993 trillion (about $96.5 billion) by Japan and the United States from July 30 to August 26, the yen still slipped back toward the ¥160 level. The cumulative intervention this year now totals ¥27.13 trillion, surpassing the 2003 record, leading markets to speculate that Tokyo may be forced to sell US Treasuries to support the yen.

A deeper issue is eroding confidence in fiscal policy. Wu Chun‑ye of Five Minerals Securities noted that Powell’s tolerance for inflation has clearly dropped, demanding that underlying inflation “clearly and quickly” return to 2%. Meanwhile, CICC argues that under a “fiscal‑driven” environment, the Fed will find it hard to stay out of the picture.

When the 10‑year US Treasury yields 4.8% represent a risk‑free return, the S&P 500’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio sits at 26× (earnings yield only 3.7%). The equity‑bond risk‑return ratio turns negative – a reversal not seen in the past two decades of asset‑allocation frameworks.

TD Securities points out that gold faces short‑term pressure but the long‑term bull market remains intact. Industry insiders warn that if the 10‑year US Treasury yield breaches 5%, global portfolio rebalancing will shift from a fine‑tuning exercise to a full‑scale reassessment of the “risk‑free rate anchor” itself. From Japan yields breaking 3% to US yields approaching 5%, the market is staging a closing ceremony for the 40‑year long‑bond bull run.

items.title: Fed鷹派聲浪踩煞車！威廉斯：升息理由還不夠
items.title_en: Fed Hawkish Tone Hits the Brakes! Williams: Not Enough Reason to Raise Rates
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周三(2日)表示，近期通膨數據令人鼓舞，隨著關稅造成的一次性價格衝擊逐漸消退，通膨正緩慢下降，目前尚無明確證據顯示Fed必須再次升息。
威廉斯接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，目前推升物價的主要因素仍是關稅，以及中東衝突造成的能源價格上漲，部分服務業通膨也依然偏高。不過，能源成本上升尚未擴散至其他服務項目，Fed也未觀察到關稅引發第二輪通膨效應，通膨預期仍受到控制。
威廉斯說：「最近的數據令人鼓舞。」隨著部分關稅影響逐漸成為過去，通膨趨勢正緩慢下滑，但目前仍無法確定現行貨幣政策是否足以確保未來一至兩年內讓通膨回到目標，或Fed是否必須採取進一步行動。
威廉斯支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月維持利率不變的決定，並認為目前利率處於適當位置，足以平衡充分就業與物價穩定的雙重使命。不過，他強調Fed仍在蒐集大量數據，之後必須重新評估政策立場。
Fed將於9月15日至16日在華盛頓召開利率會議，此前今年已連續5次按兵不動。7月會議有3名具投票權的官員主張升息1碼，顯示決策官員對政策限制程度看法不一。期貨市場一度反映，Fed本月將利率提高1碼至3.75%至4%的機率約達三分之二，但威廉斯的談話顯示，升息仍非板上釘釘。
身為Fed決策核心人物，威廉斯的立場通常代表政策辯論中的中間派看法。Fed在會議前還將取得一份最新通膨報告，市場也將關注Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(3日)的談話。
對於近期長期公債殖利率上升，威廉斯認為，主要反映美國經濟與成長前景強勁，以及AI、資料中心和科技領域的龐大投資需求，而非通膨失控或市場出現信用疑慮。
他表示，若未來出現持續性的生產力繁榮，確實可能推升不刺激也不抑制經濟的中性利率，但目前尚未看到足夠證據。威廉斯估計中性利率約為1%，實質利率雖略有上升，幅度仍相當有限。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair and New York Fed President John Williams said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that recent inflation data are encouraging, and as the one‑off price shock from tariffs fades, inflation is slowly easing, with no clear evidence that the Fed needs to raise rates again.

In an interview with CNBC, Williams noted that the main drivers of price pressures remain tariffs and higher energy prices due to the Middle‑East conflict, and some services inflation remains elevated. However, the rise in energy costs has not yet spread to other services, the Fed has not seen a second‑round inflation effect from tariffs, and inflation expectations remain under control.

Williams said, “The recent data are encouraging.” As the impact of some tariffs recedes, the inflation trend is gradually sliding down, but it is still uncertain whether the current monetary policy is sufficient to bring inflation back to target over the next one to two years, or whether the Fed must take further action.

Williams supported the Federal Open Market Committee’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and said the current rate level is appropriate to balance the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. He emphasized, however, that the Fed is still gathering a large amount of data and will have to reassess its policy stance later.

The Fed will hold its rate‑policy meeting in Washington on September 15‑16, after five consecutive pauses this year. At the July meeting, three voting members advocated a one‑basis‑point hike, showing differing views among policymakers on how restrictive policy should be. Futures once priced a roughly two‑thirds chance that the Fed would raise rates by one basis point to 3.75%‑4% this month, but Williams’s comments suggest a hike is not a foregone conclusion.

As a core member of the Fed’s decision‑making team, Williams’s stance usually reflects a centrist view in policy debates. The Fed will also receive a fresh inflation report before the meeting, and markets will watch Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Thursday (the 3rd).

Regarding the recent rise in long‑term Treasury yields, Williams said it mainly reflects a strong U.S. economy and growth outlook, as well as massive investment demand in AI, data centers and the tech sector, rather than runaway inflation or credit concerns in the market.

He added that if a sustained productivity boom materializes, it could indeed push the neutral rate higher—neither stimulating nor restraining the economy—but there is not enough evidence yet. Williams estimates the neutral rate at about 1%, and while real rates have risen slightly, the increase remains modest.

items.title: 聯鈞7月自結獲利1.48億元、年增279% 下半年擴產滿足客戶出貨
items.title_en: Lianjun Reports July Net Profit of NT$148 million, Up 279% YoY; Expands Production in H2 to Meet Customer Shipments
paras: 光通訊股聯鈞(3450)近日股價波動劇烈，遭主管機關要求公告財務資料，聯鈞自結公告上(7)月份單月稅後純益為1.48億元、年增高達279%，每股純益為1.02元。聯鈞今(2026)年第2季受惠光學產品占比持續攀升，單季EPS達2.09元，累計上半年EPS已達2.78元，已達去(2025)年獲利50％以上，前7月累計EPS為3.8元。
聯鈞股價近期也隨著業績轉佳，推升股價從7月底波段低點的338.5元，一路上漲至今日602元，波段漲幅逾7成以上。
聯鈞在法說上表示，儘管相關供應鏈已積極擴產，但AI光通訊供給量仍遠落後市場需求，預期未來幾年AI產品相關短缺情況仍持續延續，聯鈞也將持續加速擴產，以滿足客戶快速出貨的相關需求，公司董事會將陸續通過籌資案，擴大資本支出擴產。
法人表示，聯鈞近年受惠於AI帶動高速、寬頻傳輸需求快速提升，旗下COSA光學次模組產品涵蓋65G、100G至200G EML晶片，持續站穩全球委外COSA封裝領導地位，產能訂單以每年翻倍程度增長。
paras_en: Optical‑communication stock Lianjun (3450) saw extreme price volatility recently and was asked by regulators to disclose its financials. In its self‑reported figures, July’s net profit after tax was NT$148 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 279%, with earnings per share of NT$1.02. In the second quarter of 2026, the company benefited from a rising share of optical products, posting a quarterly EPS of NT$2.09 and a cumulative H1 EPS of NT$2.78, which already exceeds 50% of the profit level achieved in 2025. The cumulative EPS for the first seven months reached NT$3.80.
Lianjun’s share price has risen sharply alongside the improving performance, climbing from the low of NT$338.5 at the end of July to NT$602 today, a gain of more than 70% over the period.

The company said in its earnings briefing that although the related supply chain has been actively expanding, the supply of AI optical‑communication components still lags far behind market demand. It expects the shortage of AI‑related products to persist for several years and will continue to accelerate capacity expansion to meet customers’ rapid shipment needs. The board will sequentially approve fundraising plans to boost capital expenditures for the expansion.

Analysts note that Lianjun has recently benefited from AI‑driven growth in high‑speed, broadband transmission demand. Its COSA optical sub‑module products cover 65G, 100G to 200G EML chips, maintaining a leading position in global outsourced COSA packaging. Order volume for capacity is growing at roughly a doubling rate each year.

items.title: 友達出售新加坡廠處予威騰電子 交易金額87億元
items.title_en: AUO Sells Singapore Plant to Western Digital for 8.75 Billion NTD
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(2)日公告，將子公司AFPD位於新加坡的廠房及相關廠務附屬設施，出售給硬碟大廠威騰電子(Western Digital)，交易總金額為新加坡幣3.5億元(約新台幣 87.53億元)。
AFPD此次出售廠房的建物面積約17.7萬平方公尺(約5.35萬坪)，另有附屬設備一批，交易相對人為Western Digital (Singapore)，友達表示，處分目的為聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構。
AFPD將提出OTP予買方簽署，並提供10個營業日的選擇權期間(Option Period)，過戶前提條件將視買方是否取得當地主管機關包括但不限於Jurong Town Corporation之核准，預計處分利益待買方取得核准後確認。
友達董事長彭双浪於最近一次法說中提到，公司持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭等新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: AUO (2409-TW) announced today that it will sell its subsidiary AFPD’s plant and related facilities in Singapore to Western Digital for a total transaction amount of SGD 350 million (approximately NTD 8.753 billion).

The AFPD plant covers about 177,000 square meters (approximately 53,500 ping) and includes a batch of ancillary equipment; the counterparty is Western Digital (Singapore). AUO stated that the disposal aims to focus on a light‑asset operating model, activate assets, and optimize its financial structure.

AFPD will issue an offer to purchase (OTP) for the buyer to sign and provide a 10‑business‑day option period. Transfer conditions will depend on whether the buyer obtains approval from local authorities, including but not limited to the Jurong Town Corporation; the disposal proceeds are expected to be confirmed once approval is obtained.

In a recent earnings call, AUO Chairman Peng Shuanglang reiterated the company’s continued focus on a light‑asset operating model, asset activation, and financial structure optimization, and on phasing out less competitive legacy lines while investing in high‑yield applications such as AI’s four‑arrow technologies.

items.title: 晶片不在美國生產就課稅！盧特尼克：台灣下周再宣布最高300億美元投資
items.title_en: Semiconductors Not Made in the U.S. Will Be Taxed! Lutnick: Taiwan to Announce Up to $30 Billion Investment Next Week
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)周三(2日)表示，川普政府正考慮對進口半導體祭出新一輪關稅，並可能將課稅範圍擴大至搭載晶片的資料中心伺服器與消費性電子產品，藉此吸引更多晶片製造回流美國。
不過，新關稅預料將搭配赴美投資豁免機制，仿照川普政府對製藥業採取的模式。盧特尼克接受《CNBC》訪問時表示：「如果在美國生產，我們會提供關稅減免；如果不在美國生產，就得繳納關稅。」
川普今年1月已在美國商務部完成貿易調查後，對部分先進半導體課徵25%關稅。新一輪措施可能進一步擴大涵蓋範圍，不僅針對晶片本身，也涵蓋含有晶片的進口產品。批評者警告，此舉可能推高在美國興建資料中心的成本，但盧特尼克認為，提供本土製造豁免可望降低相關衝擊。
盧特尼克表示，目前各企業承諾投入美國半導體製造的金額已達約1.2兆美元，其中包括台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)及美光(MU-US)等公司。部分投資來自今年稍早完成的美台貿易協議，台灣承諾提供約5,000億美元投資與信用保證，以支持美國高科技製造。
他並預告，台灣下周將再宣布一批新的對美投資承諾，規模約200億至300億美元。

加拿大臨時加碼要求導致談判破局

談及美加貿易協議破局，盧特尼克再次將責任歸咎於加拿大，聲稱加方純粹出於政治理由，在最後關頭讓談判告吹，導致雙方未能在期限前達成協議，以阻止美國對加拿大商品加徵50%關稅。
盧特尼克表示，就在談判期限屆滿前幾個小時，加拿大代表團突然加入一些「瘋狂構想」，其中包括針對中型與重型卡車提出額外要求，使原本接近完成的協議生變。
他回憶，當時曾直接詢問一名加拿大部長：「你們是真的想讓談判破局嗎？」對方回答：「我不能說。」盧特尼克據此認為，加拿大是基於政治考量刻意中止談判。
不過，盧特尼克也承認，美方可能同樣在最後一刻提出新的要求，因為川普先前曾表示，這聽起來確實像是他可能採取的做法。雙方目前仍各說各話，持續互相指責對方應為貿易協議告吹負責。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick on Wednesday (Feb. 2) said the Trump administration is considering a new round of tariffs on imported semiconductors and may expand the scope to data‑center servers and consumer electronics that contain chips, in an effort to bring more chip manufacturing back to the United States.

However, the new tariffs are expected to be paired with a U.S. investment exemption mechanism, modeled after the Trump administration’s approach to the pharmaceutical industry. In a CNBC interview, Lutnick said, “If it’s made in the U.S., we’ll offer tariff relief; if it’s not made in the U.S., it will be taxed.”

Trump imposed a 25% tariff on certain advanced semiconductors in January after a trade review by the U.S. Commerce Department. The new measures could broaden the coverage to include not only the chips themselves but also imported products that contain chips. Critics warn that this could raise the cost of building data centers in the U.S., but Lutnick believes that providing domestic manufacturing exemptions can mitigate the impact.

Lutnick said that companies have already committed about $1.2 trillion to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing, including TSMC (2330‑TW) and Micron (MU‑US). Some of the investment comes from a U.S.–Taiwan trade agreement signed earlier this year, under which Taiwan pledged roughly $500 billion in investment and credit guarantees to support U.S. high‑tech manufacturing.
He also announced that Taiwan will announce another batch of U.S. investment commitments next week, in the range of $20 billion to $30 billion.

Canada’s last‑minute demands caused the trade talks to collapse. Lutnick again blamed Canada, claiming the country acted purely for political reasons and let the negotiations fail at the last moment, preventing an agreement before the deadline and stopping the U.S. from imposing a 50% tariff on Canadian goods.

Lutnick said that just hours before the deadline, the Canadian delegation suddenly introduced some “crazy ideas,” including additional demands on medium‑ and heavy‑truck imports, which derailed an almost‑completed agreement.

He recalled asking a Canadian minister directly, “Do you really want to let the negotiations collapse?” The minister replied, “I can’t say.” Lutnick concluded that Canada deliberately halted the talks for political reasons.

Nonetheless, Lutnick admitted that the U.S. may have also made new demands at the last minute, as Trump had previously indicated that such a move would be consistent with his approach. Both sides continue to blame each other for the collapse of the trade agreement.

items.title: 大立光、雙鴻等4檔飆股明起遭關禁閉 3檔處置至9/9、聯鈞至9/11
items.title_en: Largan Precision, Shuanghong and Three Other Stocks Face Trading Suspensions Starting Tomorrow; Three Halted Until Sep 9, Lianjun Until Sep 11
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告新增處置股，包括股價超過千金的光學股大立光(3008-TW)、散熱股雙鴻(3324-TW)以及光通訊股聯鈞(3450-TW)及前鼎(4908-TW)，處置時間從明(3)日起開始，除了聯鈞處置期至9月11日共7日之外，其餘3檔將關至9月9月，分盤交易均為2分鐘撮合一次。
處置原因部分，大立光為最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達32.45%，且6個營業日起迄2個營業日收盤價價差達1,520元。最近90個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達200.24%。
聯鈞處置原因為9月2日之本益比為122.11，且股價淨值比為15.7。另當日周轉率為7.56%，暨美商高盛證券商成交買進金額達新台幣1億元以上，且占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率為11.89%。單一投資人當日買進該有價證券之成交金額占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率10%以上，且達新台幣1億元以上。
雙鴻為最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.08%，且當日周轉率達11.82%。
前鼎最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.68%，且當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大6.6倍，且當日周轉率達22.44%。
大立光近期股價持續狂飆，今日在外資由賣轉買助攻下大漲3.03％，昨(1)日盤中更一度衝上7,995元寫新天價。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (the 2nd) the addition of four stocks to the special handling list: optical giant Largan Precision (3008‑TW), cooling specialist Shuanghong (3324‑TW), optical‑communication firm Lianjun (3450‑TW) and QianDing (4908‑TW). The handling period begins tomorrow (the 3rd). Except for Lianjun, which will be restricted for seven days until September 11, the other three will be suspended until September 9, with each trading session limited to a 2‑minute matching interval.

The reason for Largan Precision’s handling is that over the past six trading days its closing price rose cumulatively by 32.45%, and the price difference between the closing price six days ago and two days ago reached NT$1,520. Over the past 90 trading days, the cumulative closing‑price increase over the last two days was 200.24%.

Lianjun is being handled because its price‑to‑earnings ratio on September 2 was 122.11 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 15.7. That day its turnover rate was 7.56%, and Goldman Sachs (U.S.) bought more than NT$100 million of the stock, accounting for 11.89% of the total value‑traded securities that day. A single investor’s purchases also exceeded NT$100 million and represented over 10% of the day’s total securities turnover.
Shuanghong’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.08% based on the last transaction price, and its turnover rate on the day was 11.82%.

QianDing’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.68% based on the last transaction price, and its trading volume that day was 6.6 times the average volume of the previous 60 trading days, with a turnover rate of 22.44%.

Largan Precision’s stock has been soaring recently; today it jumped 3.03% aided by foreign investors switching from selling to buying. Yesterday (the 1st) it even surged to NT$7,995 intraday, setting a new all‑time high.

items.title: AOI設備廠牧德8月營收3.61億元續創新高年增35.68%
items.title_en: AOI Equipment Maker Mude Technology's August Revenue Hits NT$361 Million, Continuing Record High with 35.68% YoY Growth
paras: AOI設備廠牧德科技(3563-TW)今(2)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收3.61億元，續創新高，月增約0.42 %、年增約 35.68 %，累計2026年1-8月營收26.31億元，年增14.39%。牧德指出，公司營運動能穩定成長中 ，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季。
牧德表示，隨 AI 基礎建設持續擴大，電子產品朝高效能、高密度及高階化發展，帶動相關製程對精密檢測設備需求提升。牧德持續聚焦高階應用市場，未來產品布局以AI 伺服器 GPU 應用、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝為主要發展方向，透過檢測技術與產品持續升級，掌握 AI 產業鏈及高階電子製程所衍生的檢測需求。
牧德並指出，光模組 MSA 及高階載板相關應用，隨 AI 伺服器、高速交換器及高速 傳輸需求成長，對線路精度、微細化及產品可靠度要求持續提高，帶動 MSAP 及高階載板製程相關檢測需求。公司將持續強化相關檢測技術與產品開發，提升高階應用市場布局，並積極掌握新世代電子產品製程升級所帶來的市場機會。
牧德的整體接單能見度維持良好水準，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季，市場需求也優於去年同期。隨 AI 伺服器 GPU 、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝等應用同步持續發展，加上新產品陸續導入，相關市場需求可望逐步反映於公司營運動能發展。
AOI 設備廠牧德科技 2026 年第二季營收 10.47 億元，毛利率 60.41%，季減 0.17 個百分點，年減 3.82 個百分點，稅後純益 3.32 億元，季增 12.65%，年增 36.15%，每股純益 5.19 元，
牧德科技 2026 年上半年營收 19.11 億元，毛利率 60.49%，年減 3.79 個百分點，2026 年上半年稅後純益 6.27 億元，年增 14.5%，每股純益 9.8 元。
paras_en: Mude Technology (3563‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue reached NT$3.61 billion, setting a new high. The month‑over‑month increase was about 0.42% and the year‑over‑year rise about 35.68%. Cumulative revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$26.31 billion, up 14.39% YoY. Mude said its operating momentum remains stable, with some high‑end product orders already extending into the coming quarters.

Mude noted that as AI infrastructure continues to expand, electronic products are moving toward higher performance, higher density and more advanced designs, driving greater demand for precision inspection equipment in related processes. The company will keep focusing on the high‑end application market, with future product roadmaps centered on AI server GPU applications, optical module MSA, advanced substrates and advanced packaging. By continuously upgrading inspection technologies and products, Mude aims to capture the testing needs generated by the AI supply chain and high‑end electronic processes.

Mude also pointed out that applications for optical‑module MSA and advanced substrates are growing alongside AI servers, high‑speed switches and high‑speed transmission requirements. This raises demands for line accuracy, miniaturization and product reliability, boosting testing needs for MSAP and advanced‑substrate processes. The company will keep strengthening related inspection technologies and product development, enhance its high‑end market positioning, and actively seize market opportunities created by next‑generation electronic product process upgrades.

Overall order visibility for Mude remains strong, with some high‑end product orders already extending into several future quarters, and market demand exceeding that of the same period last year. As AI‑server GPU, optical‑module MSA, advanced substrate and advanced packaging applications continue to develop, and new products are gradually introduced, related market demand is expected to be reflected progressively in the company’s operating momentum.

Mude Technology reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$1.047 billion, a gross margin of 60.41% (down 0.17 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, down 3.82 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$332 million, up 12.65% quarter‑over‑quarter and 36.15% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$5.19.

For the first half of 2026, Mude posted revenue of NT$1.911 billion, a gross margin of 60.49% (down 3.79 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$627 million, up 14.5% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$9.80.

items.title: 市場震盪避風港！遠銀Bankee首創「靈活存」 活存2.435%罕見超越定存
items.title_en: Safe Haven Amid Market Turbulence: Bankee Introduces First‑Ever "Flexible Deposit" with 2.435% Current‑Account Rate Exceeding Fixed Deposit
paras: 面對全球市場震盪，不少投資人選擇暫時退守現金，卻常陷於「定存怕綁死、活存利息低」的兩難。遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行推出業界首創的「靈活存」專案，打破市場既定印象，首度將「定存與活存款項納入同一套資金配置」，更祭出活存年利率 2.435% 反超定存利率的罕見優惠，宣告正式打響數位銀行資金搶奪戰。
傳統理財觀念中，資金流動性與高收益往往不可兼得。遠東商銀 Bankee 表示，觀察到許多持有觀望資金或備用金的客戶，普遍存在「想爭取高收益，又不願犧牲調度彈性」的痛點。「靈活存」專案即是從該痛點出發，透過新機制將收益與流動性整合，創造定存與活存相互加乘的效益。
本次專案最大亮點，在於顛覆市場常規的「逆向利率操作」。民眾只要以符合條件之新資金開立一年期、固定年利率 1.78% 的定存，即可同步取得定存本金 50% 的高利活存額度，享受高達 2.435% 的活存年利率。專案門檻極具親民度，單筆最低 1 萬元即可起存，最高可達 300 萬元且不限筆數，不論是小資族或高資產客群皆能彈性參與。
以投入 100 萬元資金為例，開立一年期「靈活存」後，除 100 萬元可享固定年利率 1.78% 的定存收益外，還能額外取得最高 50 萬元的 2.435% 高利活存額度。最特別的是，該筆高利活存額度「不需一次存滿」，客戶可先鎖定高利率額度，再依據自身資金調度需求隨時存入或提領。
遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行強調，理財工具應隨市場環境與人生階段動態調整。在市場變動加劇的時代，資金主導權應回歸消費者身上。「靈活存」將單一利率選擇轉化為高彈性的資金調度工具，讓民眾在等待下一個最佳投資時機前，既能賺取高於一般定存的收益，又能保有「隨時拔槍進場」的機動性，實現資金效益最大化。
paras_en: Facing global market turbulence, many investors temporarily retreat to cash, yet often find themselves caught between the dilemma of "fixed deposits feel locked in" and "current accounts offer low interest." Bankee, a community bank of Far East Commercial Bank, has launched the industry’s first "Flexible Deposit" program, breaking the market’s conventional perception by incorporating both fixed and current deposits into a single funding strategy and offering a rare 2.435% annual rate on current deposits that surpasses the fixed deposit rate, officially launching a digital banking funding war.

In traditional financial thinking, liquidity and high returns are often seen as mutually exclusive. Bankee observed that many customers holding speculative or reserve funds generally face the pain point of wanting higher returns without sacrificing scheduling flexibility. The "Flexible Deposit" project addresses this pain point by integrating returns and liquidity through a new mechanism, creating a synergistic benefit between fixed and current deposits.

The highlight of this project lies in its reverse‑rate operation that overturns market norms. Customers who open a one‑year fixed deposit at a qualifying rate of 1.78% automatically receive a high‑interest current deposit credit equal to 50% of the fixed deposit principal, enjoying an annual rate of up to 2.435%. The program’s threshold is highly accessible: a minimum single deposit of 10,000 yuan is required, with a maximum of 3,000,000 yuan and no limit on the number of deposits, allowing both low‑income and high‑net‑worth customers to participate flexibly.

For example, with an investment of 1,000,000 yuan, opening a one‑year "Flexible Deposit" yields a fixed deposit return at 1.78% and an additional high‑interest current deposit credit of up to 500,000 yuan at 2.435%. The special feature of this high‑interest current deposit credit is that it does not need to be deposited in full at once; customers can lock in the high rate and then deposit or withdraw funds at any time according to their liquidity needs.

Bankee emphasizes that financial tools should dynamically adjust to market conditions and life stages. In an era of heightened market volatility, control of funds should return to consumers. "Flexible Deposit" transforms a single rate choice into a highly flexible funding tool, allowing people to earn returns higher than typical fixed deposits while retaining the ability to "jump in at any time," maximizing the efficiency of their capital before the next optimal investment opportunity arises.

items.title: 無懼大盤回檔！00406A除息逆勢吸金 掩護性買權策略發揮優勢
items.title_en: Undaunted by Market Pullback! 00406A Pays Dividend and Attracts Capital Against the Trend, Covered Call Strategy Shows Strength
paras: 中東地緣政治衝突再度升溫，受美股重挫拖累，台股今(2)日開低走低，終場大跌784點，收在46164.72點，跌幅1.67%，成交金額縮減至不到兆元。ETF 方面，市場交投熱絡，單日成交量突破20萬張的焦點包含群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)與主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)。其中，00406A 逢除息首日，在大盤重挫之際展現強勁抗震力，吸引買盤逆勢低接，也顯見當市場波動度放大時，反而能為掩護性買權(Covered Call)策略創造出更高的權利金收益空間，吸引資金進場布局。
法人表示，隨著地緣政治風險升溫、美債殖利率攀高，以及美股回檔等因素影響，電子權值股遭獲利了結賣壓衝擊，台積電更失守2400元整數關卡，AI伺服器、高階PCB及記憶體等族群全面走弱。不過市場資金並未完全撤出，部分轉向受惠國際油價上漲的塑化、化工及能源概念股，使其成為今日盤面少數亮點。
主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)今(2)日除息，在大盤重挫之際仍吸引買盤低接，成交量維持高檔。投資專家表示，短線盤勢仍將處於震盪加劇階段，而投資組合若建立掩護性買權(Covered Call)部位，將有機會收取更高的權利金收入。尤其近期市場呈現高檔震盪、區間整理，甚至漲一天跌一天的格局，正是權利金策略相對有利的操作環境。
對於00406A這類透過權利金創造現金流的產品而言，近期盤勢反而具有正面助益。由於市場波動放大，有利於提升權利金收入來源。同時，市場普遍認為AI資本支出成長趨勢未變，即使短線出現如今日的大幅震盪，長期最受惠的仍是00406A所持有的核心科技股；而波動率上升同步提高權利金收益，也有助於強化整體收益表現。
主動中信台灣收益ETF經理人張書廷表示，後續仍可持續觀察SEMICON Taiwan展會效應、AI供應鏈接單狀況等。儘管大盤短期內可能維持震盪整理格局，但半導體、AI伺服器、先進封裝、電力與散熱，以及高速傳輸等長線主流趨勢並未改變。

paras_en: The Middle East geopolitical conflict heated up again, and dragged down by a sharp drop in U.S. stocks, Taiwan’s market opened lower and stayed lower today (the 2nd), ending the session down 784 points at 46,164.72, a decline of 1.67%, with turnover shrinking to less than a trillion TWD. In ETFs, trading was lively; the day's volume topped 200,000 contracts for the spotlight funds including Yuanta Taiwan Weighted Index Leveraged 2 (00685L‑TW) and the actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW). On its ex‑dividend day, 00406A showed strong resilience amid the market plunge, drawing buying interest at lower levels and illustrating that when market volatility expands, a covered‑call strategy can generate higher premium income, attracting capital to position itself.

Institutions said that rising geopolitical risk, climbing U.S. Treasury yields and the pullback in U.S. equities have pressured profit‑taking sales in heavyweight electronics stocks, with TSMC slipping below the NT$2,400 round number and AI server, high‑end PCB and memory groups all weakening. However, market money has not fully fledged; some has shifted to plastic, chemical and energy concepts that benefit from higher international oil prices, making them today’s few bright spots on the board.

The actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) paid its dividend today (the 2nd) and still attracted buying at lower levels despite the market’s sharp decline, keeping volume at a high level. Investment experts say short‑term market action will remain in a heightened‑volatility phase, and portfolios that add a covered‑call position can capture higher premium income. Especially as the market now oscillates at higher levels, consolidates in a range, and even shows a pattern of up‑one‑day‑down‑the‑next, conditions are relatively favorable for premium‑generating strategies.

For products like 00406A that generate cash flow through option premiums, the recent market environment actually provides a positive boost. Amplified volatility helps raise premium income sources. At the same time, the market broadly believes the growth trend in AI capital expenditures remains intact; even though short‑term turbulence like today’s large swings occurs, the long‑term beneficiaries remain the core tech stocks held by 00406A. Higher volatility also lifts premium yields, strengthening overall return performance.

ETF manager Zhang Shuting of the actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield said that future observation will continue on the SEMICON Taiwan exhibition effect, AI supply‑chain order flow, and other factors. Although the broader market may stay in a short‑term consolidation‑oscillation pattern, long‑term mainstream trends such as semiconductors, AI servers, advanced packaging, power and cooling, and high‑speed transmission remain unchanged.

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉鴻海劉揚偉：MIT思維應轉向「Made with Taiwan」 與全球市場共同製造
items.title_en: <SEMICON> Foxconn Chairman Liu Yang-wei: MIT Mindset Should Shift to “Made with Taiwan” and Co‑manufacture with Global Markets
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉今(2)日出席半導體展大師論壇表示，全球供應鏈正在改變，台灣企業過去強調「Made in Taiwan台灣製造」的思維也必須轉變，未來應思考與市場所在國家「Made with Taiwan與台灣共同製造」。
劉揚偉指出，大約10年前就已觀察到全球供應鏈將發生改變，隨著地緣政治情勢發展，這項趨勢變得進一步加速且更具挑戰，但這其實是非常自然的發展，因為各國領導人都在尋求經濟成長與國家繁榮，也會思考如何增加當地GDP，以及為什麼當地消費的產品不能在自己的國家製造。
而對客戶來說，要的是「去風險化(De-risking)」而非「脫鉤(Decoupling)」，因此，台灣企業必須走出台灣、前往其他國家，不僅是為了滿足客戶需求，也是為了滿足消費該產品國家的需求。
劉揚偉表示，台灣擁有獨特文化、良好教育體系及穩定的政府政策，因此非常擅長做兼具「品質」與「速度」的事情，面對需求快速且龐大的情況，台灣的文化與環境適合快速適應、迅速行動。
他也引用自己在2022年在印尼舉行的B20峰會上提出的「Share, collaborate, and thrive together(分享、合作，並共同繁榮）」的概念，過去是在同一個國家完成所有事情，未來則應與其他國家分享、合作，進而共同繁榮。
劉揚偉強調，台灣過去總認為必須是「Made in Taiwan」，但從現在開始，應思考如何做到「Made with Taiwan」，與市場所在國家共同製造，如果台灣行動夠快，同時將部分生產轉移到產品將被使用的國家，雙方結合在一起，就能共同繁榮，而不僅僅是單一國家受益。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) Chairman Liu Yang‑wei attended the Semiconductor Expo Master Forum today, saying the global supply chain is changing and Taiwan’s past emphasis on “Made in Taiwan” must evolve. In the future, companies should consider “Made with Taiwan” – co‑manufacturing together with the countries where the market resides.

Liu noted that about ten years ago he already observed a shift in the global supply chain. With the development of geopolitical tensions, this trend has accelerated and become more challenging, but it is a natural evolution as leaders worldwide seek economic growth, national prosperity, higher local GDP, and wonder why products consumed locally cannot be made locally.

For customers, the priority is “de‑risking” rather than “decoupling.” Therefore, Taiwanese firms must go beyond Taiwan and operate in other countries—not only to meet customer demands but also to satisfy the needs of the nations where the products are consumed.

Liu said Taiwan’s unique culture, strong education system, and stable government policies make it especially good at delivering both quality and speed. When demand is rapid and massive, Taiwan’s culture and environment are well‑suited to adapt quickly and act swiftly.

He recalled the concept he presented at the 2022 B20 summit in Indonesia – “Share, collaborate, and thrive together.” In the past, everything was done within a single country; going forward, sharing and cooperating with other nations will lead to shared prosperity.

Liu emphasized that Taiwan has long believed it must be “Made in Taiwan,” but now should think about “Made with Taiwan,” co‑manufacturing with the market’s host countries. If Taiwan moves quickly and shifts part of production to the countries where products are used, the two sides can combine forces and achieve mutual prosperity rather than benefiting a single nation.

items.title: 全球債券大幅回檔！但與2022年慘烈災情相比仍是小巫見大巫
items.title_en: Global Bonds Plunge Sharply, Yet Still a Mere Trifle Compared to the 2022 Disaster
paras: 全球債券市場近期遭遇的拋售看來相當慘烈，但與四年前相比仍是小巫見大巫。
回顧2022年時，以聯準會(Fed)為首的各國央行展開半世紀以來最同步且迅速的貨幣政策緊縮行動，以對抗疫情後需求反彈所引發、又受到俄烏戰爭進一步推升的通膨，最終導致全球債券陷入一個世代以來首見的熊市。
如今這波拋售雖然把全球主要市場的債券殖利率推升至多年高點，但漲幅僅是2022年底那波行情的一小部分。
債券殖利率與價格走勢相反。彭博彙整的數據顯示，全球政府債券殖利率過去20日累計上升17個基點，遠低於當時20天內急升的62個基點。
以今年以來的高點至低點計算，債券價格下跌4.2%，與2022年高達23%的跌幅相去甚遠。
儘管目前債市拋售絲毫沒有停歇跡象，但殖利率迄今漲幅相對溫和，讓資深市場觀察人士稍感安心。
自1983年起便追蹤債券市場的投資管理公司GSFM駐雪梨顧問Stephen Miller說，「也許該吃顆定心丸，冷靜一下。我不能說債券現在是強力買進標的」，但以目前這類殖利率水準來看，對以收益為導向的投資人而言，「確實開始值得考慮」。
和2022年造成債市崩跌的原因相比，通膨這一次同樣是重要因素，尤其是伊朗戰爭推升能源價格的影響，但還有其他力量正在加重債券市場壓力。
日本、英國和美國等主要市場政府支出龐大，持續推高發債量，促使投資人要求更高報酬，才能持有較長天期的政府債券。與此同時，人工智慧(AI)熱潮需要龐大資金投入，也加劇資本競爭，進一步推高借貸成本。
即便如此，債券跌幅仍相對獲得控制，部分原因在於目前殖利率是從較高水準上升，因此能提供投資人更大的利息收入緩衝，以抵銷債券價格下跌的影響。相較之下，2022年初殖利率仍接近歷史低點。
今年彭博全球國債總報酬指數成分債券的平均票面利率為2.68%，從2022年的1.84%上升。
摩根大通資產管理公司(JPMorgan Asset Management)駐墨爾本全球市場策略師Kerry Craig說：「對每個經濟體而言，情況並沒有債市表現看起來那麼糟。」他指出，在澳洲等部分市場，投資人甚至可能高估央行升息幅度。
近期經濟數據也支持這項看法。美國部分關鍵經濟數據令人失望，7月非農就業人數下滑，零售銷售也意外下降。日本第2經濟季成長同樣低於預期。
儘管如此，目前還沒人敢斷言殖利率已經觸頂。在能源價格推升通膨的情況下，市場持續押注升息，加上大量政府發債把殖利率進一步推高，債券價格可能還有進一步下跌空間。
日本殖利率上升也是另一項潛在壓力來源，因為日本債券殖利率走高可能吸引全球資金回流日本。
作為全球借貸成本重要基準的10年期美債殖利率，在周三(2日)升至4.81%，創2023年底以來最高，進一步加重其他已開發市場債券的壓力。日本10年期公債殖利率周二觸及3%，為本世紀首次突破這一關卡。
不過從市場波動率降低這一點可以看出，投資人對這一波債市拋售的承受度正在提高：全球政府債券殖利率波動率，已從5月的56個基點高峰下降至37個基點。而在2022年，該指標曾大幅飆升，並在隔年3月攀抵約92個基點。
三井住友信託銀行(Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank)駐東京資深市場策略師Ayako Sera說：「債券市場的負面因素正在逐步累積，但截至目前為止，還沒有出現足以迫使投資人撤出市場的決定性催化劑。」

paras_en: The recent sell‑off in the global bond market looks severe, but it is a mere trifle compared with four years ago.

Looking back to 2022, central banks led by the Federal Reserve launched the most synchronized and rapid monetary tightening in half a century to combat post‑pandemic demand rebound‑driven inflation that was further amplified by the Russia‑Ukraine war, ultimately plunging global bonds into a generational bear market.
Now this wave of selling has pushed yields in major markets to multi‑year highs, yet the rise is only a fraction of the surge seen at the end of 2022.

Bond yields move opposite to prices. Bloomberg‑compiled data show that global government bond yields have risen 17 basis points over the past 20 days, far below the 62‑basis‑point jump in the same span back then.
From this year’s peak to trough, bond prices have fallen 4.2%, a far cry from the 23% plunge recorded in 2022.
Although the bond‑market sell‑off shows no sign of abating, the modest rise in yields so far gives seasoned market observers a bit of comfort.

Stephen Miller, a Sydney‑based adviser at GSFM, which has tracked the bond market since 1983, said, “Maybe take a calming pill and step back. I can’t say bonds are a strong buy right now,” but at current yield levels, “they do start to look worth considering for yield‑focused investors.”

Compared with the drivers of the 2022 bond‑market collapse, inflation remains a key factor this time, especially the impact of the Iran war on energy prices, but other forces are also adding pressure to the market.

Large fiscal outlays in major economies such as Japan, the UK and the US keep issuance high, forcing investors to demand higher returns to hold longer‑dated sovereigns. At the same time, the AI boom requires massive capital, intensifying competition for funds and pushing borrowing costs higher.

Nevertheless, bond declines remain relatively contained, partly because yields are rising from already elevated levels, providing investors with larger interest‑income buffers to offset price drops. By contrast, yields at the start of 2022 were still near historic lows.
The average coupon of the bonds that make up Bloomberg’s Global Government Bond Total Return Index this year is 2.68%, up from 1.84% in 2022.

Kerry Craig, a global market strategist in Melbourne for JPMorgan Asset Management, said, “The situation isn’t as bleak as bond performance alone suggests for any economy.” He noted that in markets such as Australia, investors may even be over‑estimating central‑bank rate hikes.

Recent economic data support that view. Key U.S. indicators disappointed, with July non‑farm payrolls falling and retail sales unexpectedly dropping. Japan’s second‑quarter growth also came in below expectations.

Nonetheless, no one can yet claim yields have peaked. With energy‑price‑driven inflation, markets continue betting on further rate hikes, and massive sovereign issuance pushes yields higher, leaving room for bond prices to fall further.
Rising Japanese yields add another potential pressure source, as higher Japan bond yields could attract global capital back to Japan.

The benchmark 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield, a key global borrowing cost indicator, rose to 4.81% on Wednesday (the 2nd), its highest since the end of 2023, further stressing other developed‑market bonds. Japan’s 10‑year gilt hit 3% on Tuesday, a first‑century breakthrough.

However, lower volatility shows investors are becoming more tolerant of this bond‑sell‑off: global government bond yield volatility has fallen from a May peak of 56 basis points to 37 basis points. In 2022 the metric surged and reached about 92 basis points in March of the following year.

Ayako Sera, a senior market strategist in Tokyo for Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said, “Negative factors in the bond market are accumulating gradually, but so far there’s no decisive catalyst that would force investors out of the market.”

items.title: Uber突然大裁員！3300人丟飯碗 完全遠距員工只留1%
items.title_en: Uber Announces Massive Layoffs: 3,300 Jobs Cut, Only 1% of Staff Remain Fully Remote
paras: 叫車平台Uber(UBER-US)周三(2日)宣布，將在全球裁減約3,300個職位，相當於員工總數的10%，為新冠疫情以來最大規模裁員。公司希望藉此精簡管理層級、加快決策速度，並將節省的資金重新投入叫車、外送及無人計程車業務。消息激勵Uber股價走揚，盤中漲近1.7%。
執行長柯霍斯洛夏西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在內部信中表示，Uber過去5年營收接近成長兩倍，並推出新產品、跨足更多業務及擴大顧客規模，但快速成長也帶來更多管理層級、協調工作及權責不清等問題，部分適合公司規模較小時期的組織架構，如今已無法滿足需求。
他強調，這次調整並非否定受影響員工的貢獻，而是希望建立更精簡的組織，讓權責更加明確、決策更快速，使員工把更多時間投入產品開發及服務顧客，而非反覆協調。

大砍管理層、遠距職缺僅留1%

Uber將把管理職位減少20%，部分主管將改任不帶人的專業職務，但公司並未說明有多少主管會遭到裁撤，這次裁員也涵蓋非管理職員工。位於執行長以下至少7個管理層級的員工人數將減少20%，僅有一至兩名成員的「微型團隊」則將縮減近半。
公司也將整併部分重疊部門，包括把餐廳、零售及白牌外送服務的3個營運團隊統合，並合併核心服務工程與科學團隊，希望簡化組織架構及提高資本配置效率。
Uber同時進一步收緊遠距工作政策，未來僅約1%的員工可以完全遠距辦公，絕大多數現有遠距員工將被要求轉往辦公室。全球團隊將集中在紐約與舊金山等主要據點，區域、地方及科技團隊也會移往指定中心，並持續執行每周進辦公室3天的混合工作制度。
這是Uber自2020年5月以來最大規模裁員。當時疫情導致叫車需求崩跌，公司裁減6,700人、接近員工總數四分之一。完成本輪裁員後，Uber員工總數將降至略低於3萬人，大致回到2021年的水準。

省下資金轉攻無人計程車

這次重整正值Uber面臨無人計程車競爭升溫。Waymo目前透過Uber應用程式在奧斯汀與亞特蘭大提供服務，但也持續在未與Uber合作的市場獨立擴張；特斯拉(TSLA-US)等競爭對手同樣加快布局，使投資人擔心無人駕駛車隊壯大後，可能削弱Uber連結車輛與乘客的中介地位。
為守住市場地位，Uber承諾未來數年投入超過100億美元發展無人計程車合作，投資開發自駕系統的業者，並將自身打造為乘客叫車時首選的無人駕駛服務平台。公司過去一年也重新調整資本配置，投資Avride、Lucid(LCID-US)、Nuro及Rivian(RIVN-US)等業者。
柯霍斯洛夏西並未像部分科技業主管一樣，將裁員直接歸因於AI，但組織調整同樣包含擴大運用AI處理日常營運。今年科技業以提升AI效率為由的裁員潮持續，Layoffs.fyi統計顯示，近390家公司已合計裁減逾12.3萬人。
Uber今年股價累計下跌近8%，表現落後標普500指數及競爭對手Lyft(LYFT-US)。公司希望透過一次完成大規模重整，降低反覆調整對員工的干擾，並把節省的成本投入成長、創新、司機、外送員與商家服務，以及無人駕駛的長期布局。
paras_en: Ride‑hailing platform Uber (UBER‑US) announced on Wednesday (the 2nd) that it will cut roughly 3,300 positions worldwide, about 10% of its workforce, marking the largest layoff since the COVID‑19 pandemic. The company says the move will streamline management layers, speed up decision‑making and redeploy the saved capital into ride‑hailing, delivery and autonomous‑taxi businesses. The news lifted Uber’s share price, which rose about 1.7% intraday.

CEO Dara Khosrowshahi wrote in an internal memo that Uber’s revenue has nearly doubled over the past five years while the firm launched new products, entered more businesses and expanded its customer base. However, that rapid growth also added management layers, coordination burdens and unclear responsibilities, and structures that made sense when the company was smaller no longer meet its needs.

He stressed that the restructuring does not diminish the contributions of affected employees; rather, it aims to create a leaner organization with clearer accountability and faster decisions, allowing staff to spend more time on product development and serving customers instead of endless coordination.

A major cut to management and a near‑total end to remote‑only roles. Uber will reduce management positions by 20%, with some supervisors shifted to individual contributor roles that have no direct reports. The company did not disclose how many managers will be let go, and the layoffs also affect non‑managerial staff. Employees at least seven levels below the CEO will see a 20% headcount reduction, and “micro‑teams” of one or two people will be cut by almost half.

The firm will also consolidate overlapping departments, merging three operations teams that handle restaurants, retail and white‑label delivery into a single unit, and combining core services engineering with the science team, in order to simplify the org chart and improve capital allocation efficiency.

Uber is tightening its remote‑work policy, allowing only about 1% of employees to work fully remotely in the future; the vast majority of current remote workers will be required to return to the office. Global teams will be concentrated in major hubs such as New York and San Francisco, while regional, local and tech teams will move to designated centers and continue a hybrid schedule of three days in the office per week.

This is Uber’s biggest layoff since May 2020, when the pandemic caused a collapse in ride‑hailing demand and the company cut 6,700 jobs—nearly a quarter of its workforce. After this round, Uber’s headcount will fall to just under 30,000, roughly returning to its 2021 level.

Saving cash to fund autonomous taxis. The restructuring comes as competition in driverless‑car services heats up. Waymo currently offers rides through the Uber app in Austin and Atlanta but is also expanding independently in markets where it does not partner with Uber; rivals such as Tesla (TSLA‑US) are accelerating their own efforts, prompting investors to worry that a large autonomous fleet could erode Uber’s role as the intermediary between drivers and passengers.

To protect its market position, Uber has pledged to invest more than $10 billion over the next few years in autonomous‑taxi collaborations and in companies developing self‑driving technology, positioning itself as the preferred platform for passengers when autonomous rides become available. Over the past year the company also reshuffled capital toward investments in Avride, Lucid (LCID‑US), Nuro and Rivian (RIVN‑US).

Khosrowshahi did not, unlike some tech CEOs, blame AI directly for the layoffs, but the reorganization does include broader use of AI for routine operations. This year’s tech‑sector wave of AI‑driven cuts continues, with Layoffs.fyi reporting that nearly 390 companies have collectively shed more than 123,000 jobs.

Uber’s stock has fallen almost 8% so far this year, underperforming the S&P 500 and rival Lyft (LYFT‑US). The company hopes that a single, large‑scale restructuring will reduce the disruptive impact of repeated adjustments on employees and redirect the saved costs into growth, innovation, drivers, couriers, merchant services and the long‑term rollout of autonomous driving.

items.title: 〈財報前瞻〉市值蒸發5200億美元 博通能靠AI財測上演輝達式大漲？
items.title_en: AVGO's Market Value Dwindles $520 Billion: Can AI Forecast Spark a Nvidia-Style Rally?
paras: 博通(AVGO-US)將於周三(2日)美股盤後公布會計年度第三季財報。在股價自6月高點重挫23%、市值蒸發約5,200億美元後，投資人期待這家全球市值第三大晶片製造商能複製輝達(NVDA-US)上周財報後的強勁漲勢，靠優於預期的業績與展望扭轉頹勢。
輝達上周公布亮眼財報，並預估下一個會計年度營收將成長70%，帶動股價創2025年4月以來最佳單日表現。持有博通股票的Advisors Capital Management投資組合經理JoAnne Feeney表示，如果博通管理層也提出強勁預測，股價可能出現類似反應。

財測陰影導致市值蒸發5200億美元

博通股價自6月2日創下歷史收盤新高以來下跌23%，成為同期標普500指數表現最差的30檔成分股之一，也抹去今年前5個月超過30%的大部分漲幅。
這波跌勢始於博通6月4日公布的第二季財報。公司當時預估第三季AI半導體營收將達160億美元，遠低於分析師預期的逾170億美元，導致股價隔日暴跌13%，創至少2009年以來最慘財報後表現。
這項預測也與博通第一季釋出的樂觀訊號形成強烈落差。執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)當時預估，2027年AI晶片銷售額將超過1,000億美元。Feeney指出，投資人尤其在意「超過」究竟代表多大上升空間，如果管理層能提供更明確細節，可能成為推升股價的重要催化劑。
華爾街預估，博通第三季每股盈餘將年增210%至2.63美元，營收則成長85%至294億美元。儘管超大規模雲端服務業者仍計畫投入數千億美元建設AI基礎設施，但晶片供應受限，投資人也日益擔心龐大資本支出能否轉化為實際報酬。
Laffer Tengler Investments資深股票分析師Jamie Meyers表示，市場瀰漫大量恐懼，而且並非博通獨有，而是籠罩整個AI交易。

AI客戶、毛利率與市占成財報焦點

股價大幅回落也讓博通估值變得較具吸引力。目前其預估本益比約21倍，略高於過去10年平均的18倍，但已遠低於去年12月的42倍及今年6月的32倍。Benchmark Equity Research分析師Cody Acree認為，這為短線投資創造更有利的進場條件。
除財務數據與展望外，投資人也將關注博通的客戶進展。蘋果(AAPL-US)7月宣布擴大與博通的合作，由博通供應新款客製化晶片，合作價值超過300億美元。博通也與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google、Anthropic、OpenAI及Meta(META-US)簽有長期合作協議。
市場也希望管理層證明，晶片需求並非由循環融資交易人為製造，並說明博通是否在客製化晶片市場遭到Alphabet與邁威爾(MRVL-US)搶走市占率。記憶體成本居高不下，使整體晶片業毛利率承壓，博通基礎設施軟體部門的營運狀況同樣是關注焦點。
即使財報全面優於預期，AI類股近期動能受挫，投資人態度轉趨謹慎，博通股價仍未必立即反彈。不過，看好長期前景的多頭認為，只要公司證明AI業務能維持陳福陽所說的「可持續且持續加速」成長軌跡，股價仍有可觀上漲空間。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) will announce its fiscal third-quarter earnings after the close on Wednesday (Feb. 2). After the stock plunged 23% from its June high and the company’s market value evaporated roughly $520 billion, investors are hoping the world’s third‑largest chipmaker can replicate Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) strong rally following last week’s earnings, turning the downturn around with better‑than‑expected results and outlook.

Last week, Nvidia released impressive earnings and projected next fiscal year revenue growth of 70%, driving the stock to its best single‑day performance since April 2025. Advisors Capital Management portfolio manager JoAnne Feeney, who holds Broadcom shares, said that if Broadcom’s management also issued a robust forecast, the stock could react similarly.

The shadow of earnings forecasts has caused a $520 billion market value loss. Broadcom’s share price has fallen 23% since hitting a record closing high on June 2, making it one of the 30 worst‑performing S&P 500 components for the period and wiping out most of the over‑30% gain seen in the first five months of the year.

The decline began with Broadcom’s Q2 earnings release on June 4. The company then projected Q3 AI‑semiconductor revenue of $16 billion, far below analysts’ expectation of over $17 billion, causing the stock to drop 13% the next day and marking its worst post‑earnings performance since at least 2009.

This forecast also starkly contrasted with the optimistic signals released in Q1. CEO Hock Tan had projected that AI chip sales would exceed $100 billion by 2027. Feeney noted that investors are particularly concerned about what “exceed” actually means in terms of upside potential, and that clearer detail from management could become a key catalyst for the stock’s rise.

Wall Street estimates Broadcom’s Q3 earnings per share to rise 210% to $2.63, with revenue growing 85% to $29.4 billion. Although large cloud‑service providers still plan to invest trillions of dollars in AI infrastructure, chip supply constraints and growing investor concern about whether massive capital expenditures will translate into real returns are mounting.
Jamie Meyers, senior equity analyst at Laffer Tengler Investments, said that the market is saturated with fear, and it’s not unique to Broadcom but blankets the entire AI trading space.

AI customers, gross margin, and market share are the focus of the earnings report. The sharp decline in share price has made Broadcom’s valuation more attractive. Its current price‑earnings ratio is about 21×, slightly above the 10‑year average of 18×, but far below the 42× seen in December 2023 and the 32× in June 2024. Benchmark Equity Research analyst Cody Acree believes this creates more favorable entry conditions for short‑term investors.

Beyond financial data and outlook, investors will also focus on Broadcom’s customer progress. Apple (AAPL-US) announced in July that it would expand its partnership with Broadcom, supplying new custom chips valued at over $30 billion. Broadcom also has long‑term agreements with Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiaries Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Meta (META-US).

The market also wants management to prove that chip demand is not merely a result of cyclical financing traders and to explain whether Broadcom has lost market share in the custom‑chip market to Alphabet and Marvell (MRVL-US). Rising memory costs are putting pressure on overall chip gross margins, and the operating condition of Broadcom’s infrastructure software division is also a focus.

Even if the earnings report exceeds expectations, AI stocks have recently lost momentum and investor sentiment has become more cautious, so Broadcom’s share price may not rebound immediately. However, long‑term bullish investors believe that as long as the company can demonstrate that its AI business can maintain the “sustainable and continuously accelerating” growth trajectory Hock Tan described, the stock still has significant upside potential.

items.title: Fed鷹派聲浪踩煞車！威廉斯：升息理由還不夠
items.title_en: Fed Hawkish Tone Hits the Brakes! Williams: Not Enough Reason to Raise Rates
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周三(2日)表示，近期通膨數據令人鼓舞，隨著關稅造成的一次性價格衝擊逐漸消退，通膨正緩慢下降，目前尚無明確證據顯示Fed必須再次升息。
威廉斯接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，目前推升物價的主要因素仍是關稅，以及中東衝突造成的能源價格上漲，部分服務業通膨也依然偏高。不過，能源成本上升尚未擴散至其他服務項目，Fed也未觀察到關稅引發第二輪通膨效應，通膨預期仍受到控制。
威廉斯說：「最近的數據令人鼓舞。」隨著部分關稅影響逐漸成為過去，通膨趨勢正緩慢下滑，但目前仍無法確定現行貨幣政策是否足以確保未來一至兩年內讓通膨回到目標，或Fed是否必須採取進一步行動。
威廉斯支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月維持利率不變的決定，並認為目前利率處於適當位置，足以平衡充分就業與物價穩定的雙重使命。不過，他強調Fed仍在蒐集大量數據，之後必須重新評估政策立場。
Fed將於9月15日至16日在華盛頓召開利率會議，此前今年已連續5次按兵不動。7月會議有3名具投票權的官員主張升息1碼，顯示決策官員對政策限制程度看法不一。期貨市場一度反映，Fed本月將利率提高1碼至3.75%至4%的機率約達三分之二，但威廉斯的談話顯示，升息仍非板上釘釘。
身為Fed決策核心人物，威廉斯的立場通常代表政策辯論中的中間派看法。Fed在會議前還將取得一份最新通膨報告，市場也將關注Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(3日)的談話。
對於近期長期公債殖利率上升，威廉斯認為，主要反映美國經濟與成長前景強勁，以及AI、資料中心和科技領域的龐大投資需求，而非通膨失控或市場出現信用疑慮。
他表示，若未來出現持續性的生產力繁榮，確實可能推升不刺激也不抑制經濟的中性利率，但目前尚未看到足夠證據。威廉斯估計中性利率約為1%，實質利率雖略有上升，幅度仍相當有限。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair and New York Fed President John Williams said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that recent inflation data are encouraging, and as the one‑off price shock from tariffs fades, inflation is slowly easing, with no clear evidence that the Fed needs to raise rates again.

In an interview with CNBC, Williams noted that the main drivers of price pressures remain tariffs and higher energy prices due to the Middle‑East conflict, and some services inflation remains elevated. However, the rise in energy costs has not yet spread to other services, the Fed has not seen a second‑round inflation effect from tariffs, and inflation expectations remain under control.

Williams said, “The recent data are encouraging.” As the impact of some tariffs recedes, the inflation trend is gradually sliding down, but it is still uncertain whether the current monetary policy is sufficient to bring inflation back to target over the next one to two years, or whether the Fed must take further action.

Williams supported the Federal Open Market Committee’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and said the current rate level is appropriate to balance the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. He emphasized, however, that the Fed is still gathering a large amount of data and will have to reassess its policy stance later.

The Fed will hold its rate‑policy meeting in Washington on September 15‑16, after five consecutive pauses this year. At the July meeting, three voting members advocated a one‑basis‑point hike, showing differing views among policymakers on how restrictive policy should be. Futures once priced a roughly two‑thirds chance that the Fed would raise rates by one basis point to 3.75%‑4% this month, but Williams’s comments suggest a hike is not a foregone conclusion.

As a core member of the Fed’s decision‑making team, Williams’s stance usually reflects a centrist view in policy debates. The Fed will also receive a fresh inflation report before the meeting, and markets will watch Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Thursday (the 3rd).

Regarding the recent rise in long‑term Treasury yields, Williams said it mainly reflects a strong U.S. economy and growth outlook, as well as massive investment demand in AI, data centers and the tech sector, rather than runaway inflation or credit concerns in the market.

He added that if a sustained productivity boom materializes, it could indeed push the neutral rate higher—neither stimulating nor restraining the economy—but there is not enough evidence yet. Williams estimates the neutral rate at about 1%, and while real rates have risen slightly, the increase remains modest.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價回落抵消美債殖利率壓力 主要指數變動不大
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Flat as Oil Prices Slip Off Highs, Offsetting Treasury Yield Pressure
paras: 美股主要指數周三(2日)開盤變動不大，油價自高檔回落，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，但美債殖利率仍處於多年高點，持續壓抑投資人風險偏好。
西德州中級原油跌破每桶90美元，中止因美伊爭奪荷姆茲海峽控制權而引發的連兩日漲勢；美國10年期公債殖利率在觸及兩年高點後大致持平。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近260點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近20點或0.07%，標普 500 指數漲近0.1%，費城半導體指數跌近0.1%。台積電 ADR 漲近0.3%。
國際油價中止連日漲勢，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，美股期指周三(2日)盤前收斂跌幅，美國公券價格同步走高。不過，全球公債殖利率仍上升壓力，加上主要央行可能在本月升息，市場情緒依然謹慎。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨大致持平。戴爾科技(DELL-US)受強勁營收預測激勵，盤前股價上漲。歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.3%，亞洲股市創兩周來最大跌幅，美元變動不大。
布蘭特原油在連續兩個交易日上漲後回落至每桶94美元附近。美國公債逆勢上揚，30年期美債殖利率下跌2個基點至5.25%，但其他多數市場的債券價格仍然走低。周三公布的ADP數據顯示，美國8月民間就業人口增加3.8萬人，低於預期，反映勞動市場招聘動能放緩。
油價回落暫時減輕市場壓力。此前能源價格持續上漲，加深投資人對通膨再度升溫的憂慮，也使原本已受到政府大舉舉債及企業融資需求壓迫的債市進一步走弱。
交易員目前預估，包括聯準會(Fed)在內的三家主要央行，本月升息機率均已超過50%，其中Fed升息機率約為65%。ING策略師Chris Turner指出，市場新的基本假設似乎已轉為Fed終究會在9月升息。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)已清楚表明，通膨下降速度仍不足以回到目標，加上經濟維持一定韌性，Fed可能必須採取行動。
儘管全球債市承受賣壓，但殖利率升幅相對溫和，仍為交易員帶來些許安慰。法國巴黎銀行財富管理策略師Stephan Kemper表示，本輪債市下跌有秩序且範圍廣泛，並非由信用風險或流動性壓力引發，顯示市場正在反映利率將在更長時間維持高檔，而不是預示信用危機或經濟衰退。
Kemper認為，殖利率能否回落的關鍵仍在通膨預期。如果長天期殖利率壓力獲得緩解，考量企業基本面依然強勁，股市可能出現大幅上漲。企業現金部位在AI支出激增之際仍重返歷史高點，也為股市提供支撐。今年全球股票市場已吸引約1.1兆美元資金，創2021年以來最大流入。
